meta.visualization_rationale: Which drug / biologicals appear together in the same trials is a relationship question: nodes are entities, edges link entities that share trials.

plan.interpretation: Network of drugs that frequently co-occur in combination studies for pancreatic cancer.
assumptions: Interpreted 'combination studies' as studies involving multiple drugs co-occurring in the same trial.

meta.counting_rule: Node weight = trials listing the entity; edge weight = trials listing both entities. Drug names are normalised (dose/route/parentheticals removed, combinations split); placebo/standard-of-care arms are excluded.

rendering.sort: nodes and edges descending by trial_count
